device_entry.name: Bronkhorst EL-FLOW 气体质量流量控制器
device_entry.name_en: Bronkhorst EL-FLOW gas mass flow controller
tags: 化工放大与连续工艺优化
device_entry.description: 一种带控制阀的气体质量流量控制器，用于测量并精密调节实验或工艺气体流量。它常用于气体输送、混气、反应供气以及其他需要稳定流量设定的实验室和过程控制场景。
device_entry.description_en: A gas mass flow controller with an integrated control valve, used to measure and precisely regulate gas flow in laboratory or process systems. It is commonly used for gas delivery, gas mixing, reactor feed control, and other applications requiring stable flow setpoints.

schema.description_en: Send a low-level command to the flow controller.

schema.description: 读取流量控制器返回的数据。
schema.description_en: Read the response data from the flow controller.

existing_tags.name: 化工放大与连续工艺优化
existing_tags.rationale: 其描述包含过程控制、稳定流量设定和反应供气，符合连续工艺与过程优化场景。

existing_tags.rationale: 稳定输送和调节气体流量、进行混气与反应供气，和流动反应系统高度相关。
